trigger: an operator reads the fragment's 'a hot code upgrade reduces an old owner's AgentInfo' and takes hot upgrade as a supported path, while docs/user-manual/gateway.md says hot upgrade is unsupported; the fragment also names the internal function yuzu_gw_agent:get_info/1
classification_rationale: no contradiction with code; operator-facing phrasing only
summary: Gate 2 docs-writer finding 1: reword the hot-upgrade clause so it does not read as a supported deployment path, and consider dropping the internal function name from an operator-facing fragment.

trigger: a reader months later cannot trace the record-field comment's '26 KB ... measured 2026-10-26' figure, or the 'Phase 1c G1' label used in test names, to any source in the repo

summary: Gate 3 QE SHOULD-1: no test asserts that the registry row carries the agent's hostname after G1 (the source ListAgents/QueryInventory read).

classification_rationale: missing restart-path coverage; reporter label MEDIUM, derived band from its facts is HIGH
summary: Gate 3 QE SHOULD-2: the owner-restart path is not proven to keep the hostname.

summary: Gate 3 QE SHOULD-3 (derived LOW): key shapes of hostname_of/1 untested.

summary: Gate 4 unhappy-path UP-1: hot downgrade across G1 crashes owners.

trigger: a raw module load (l(yuzu_gw_agent) / code:load_file) without sys:change_code leaves old records with a map in the hostname slot; GetAgent fails to encode and register_again on an upstream reconnect writes the map into the registry row, so ListAgents pages holding that row fail
classification_rationale: introduced: the slot's shape never changed before G1; mitigation is a map-tolerant read or documenting always sys:change_code / restart
summary: Gate 4 unhappy-path UP-2: a module load without state conversion can poison the registry row.

summary: Gate 4 unhappy-path UP-3: untested chained code_change path.
